local_feature_screen.purpose: Supplementary candidate-family screen, not authoritative provenance evidence
local_feature_screen.method: OpenCV SIFT; diffuse maps grayscale resized to 1024x1024, nfeatures=2000, BF nearest-neighbor ratio<0.7, homography RANSAC threshold=3px. CPU only. No image files generated.
local_feature_screen.interpretation: No strong positive overlap found. Four or five inliers are insufficient to infer a shared texture; low texture/repetition and transformations limit recall. Negative results do not establish independent provenance.
